ei.title: 5번: The Misunderstanding of the Manhattan Deal
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in what is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various indigenous tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They paid just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① arrived=도착했다(과거시제 정상), ② occupied=점유된(수동태 정상), ③ called→calling 오류(과거분사가 맞음), ④ related=관련된(과거분사 정상)
det.analysis:
❌ ① arrived: 'Dutch settlers had just arrived' — 과거완료 had+과거분사 정상
❌ ② occupied: 'was already occupied by' — 수동태 be+과거분사 정상
✅ ③ calling: 'an indigenous tribe called the Lenape'에서 called는 과거분사로 tribe을 수식(~라고 불리는). calling(현재분사)으로 바꾸면 능동의미가 되어 부적절
❌ ④ related: 'differences related to' — 과거분사의 후치 수식 정상
det.tip: called the Lenape = Lenape라고 불리는. 부족이 불리는(수동) 것이므로 과거분사 called가 맞음

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① what=~인 것(관계대명사 정상), ② entire=전체의(형용사 정상), ③ belonged=속했다(과거시제 정상), ④ shared→sharing 오류(조동사 뒤 수동태 필요)
det.analysis:
❌ ① what: 'in what is now the northeastern US' — 관계대명사 what(~인 것) 정상
❌ ② entire: 'the entire island of Manhattan' — 형용사 수식 정상
❌ ③ belonged: 'The island... belonged to the Lenape' — 과거시제 정상
✅ ④ sharing: 'land could be shared' — 조동사 could + be + 과거분사(수동태) 구조. sharing(현재분사)은 수동태 구조에 사용 불가
det.tip: could be shared = 공유될 수 있었다. 조동사+be+과거분사 수동태 구조

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① taken=일어난(현재완료 정상), ② had→has 오류(과거완료 had가 맞음), ③ would have been=~이었을 것이다(가정법 정상), ④ agreeing=동의하는(진행형 정상)
det.analysis:
❌ ① taken: 'may have taken place' — 조동사+완료형 정상
✅ ② has: 'Dutch settlers has just arrived' — 주어가 복수(settlers)이므로 has(3인칭 단수)는 오류. 과거완료 had가 맞음
❌ ③ would have been: 'would have been strange' — 가정법 과거완료 정상
❌ ④ agreeing: 'they were agreeing to let' — 과거진행 be+현재분사 정상
det.tip: settlers(복수) + had(과거완료). has는 3인칭 단수용으로 복수 주어와 불일치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① cause 오류→정답 caused(would have + 과거분사 필요), ② sold=팔리다(정상), ③ use=사용하다(정상), ④ growing=재배하는(정상)
det.analysis:
✅ ① cause: 'would have likely cause a big misunderstanding' — would have + 과거분사(caused) 구조에서 원형 cause는 오류
❌ ② sold: 'not sold' — 수동태 과거분사 정상
❌ ③ use: 'to let the Dutch use' — 사역동사 let+목적어+원형 정상

det.tip: would have + p.p. = 가정법 과거완료. would have caused(야기했을 것이다). cause(원형)는 불가

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① shocking=충격적인(적절), ② entire→partial 오류(24달러에 맨해튼 '전체'를 샀기에 partial은 부적절), ③ wild=야생의(적절), ④ certain=특정한(적절)
det.analysis:
❌ ① shocking: '충격적인 거래' — 24달러에 맨해튼을 산 거래는 충격적이므로 적절
✅ ② partial: '맨해튼 섬의 일부'라고 하면 거래의 충격성이 사라짐. 원문은 entire(전체)로 섬 전체를 샀다는 것이 핵심
❌ ③ wild: '야생 동물(wild animals)' — 원문 일치
❌ ④ certain: '특정 목적(certain purposes)' — 원문 일치
det.tip: the entire island = 섬 전체. 24달러로 섬 전체를 샀다는 충격. partial(일부)이면 충격 반감

If this legend is true, ③<u>cultural</u> differences related to the idea of property rights would have likely caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources ④<u>appealed</u> to the Lenape, and the idea of "selling" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① bargains=거래(적절), ② indigenous=토착의(적절), ③ cultural=문화적인(적절), ④ belonged→appealed 오류(섬이 Lenape에게 '매력적이었다'가 아니라 '속했다')
det.analysis:
❌ ① bargains: '역사상 가장 놀라운 거래(bargains)' — 적절
❌ ② indigenous: '토착 부족(indigenous tribes)' — 적절
❌ ③ cultural: '문화적 차이(cultural differences)' — 적절
✅ ④ appealed: 원문은 belonged(속했다). 'The island... appealed to the Lenape'라고 하면 '그 섬이 Lenape에게 매력적이었다'가 되어 소유 관계를 나타내지 못함
det.tip: belonged to = ~에 속하다, ~의 소유이다. appealed to = ~에게 매력적이다/호소하다. 소유 관계 vs 감정

questions.passage: One of the most amazing bargains in history may have taken place in 1626. Dutch settlers had just arrived in ①<u>what</u> is now the northeastern US. The land, however, was already occupied by various indigenous tribes. According to legend, the Dutch made a shocking deal with an indigenous tribe called the Lenape. They ②<u>paid</u> just $24 worth of beads and small items for the entire island of Manhattan. If this legend is true, cultural differences related to the idea of property rights would have ③<u>like</u> caused a big misunderstanding. The island full of wild animals and natural resources belonged to the Lenape, and the idea of "④<u>selling</u>" their land would have been strange. In their eyes, land could be shared, but not sold. They most likely thought they were agreeing to let the Dutch use the land only for certain purposes, such as keeping animals or growing crops.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① what=관계대명사(정상), ② paid=지불했다(정상), ③ likely→like 오류(부사 likely가 맞음), ④ selling=파는 것(동명사 정상)
det.analysis:
❌ ① what: 'in what is now' — 관계대명사 what(~인 것) 정상
❌ ② paid: 'They paid just $24' — 과거시제 정상
✅ ③ like: 'would have like caused' — 부사 likely(아마도)가 조동사구와 본동사 사이에 와야 함. like(~처럼)는 전치사/형용사로 이 위치에서 부사 역할 불가
❌ ④ selling: 'the idea of selling' — 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 정상
det.tip: would have likely caused = 아마도 야기했을 것이다. likely(부사) vs like(전치사). 위치상 부사가 필요
